owner.rule: Exact two-part owner check BEFORE any5C overlay, BCD/resource, source pose or legacy indexed state access. No temporary identity swap. Preserve incoming AXYP on every foreign dispatch fallback.

early_fences.admitted: RdHostPlayerPhase before GuestHurtTicks, old down+LR suppression, legacy Samus/physics/climb dispatch. Read SavedJoypadBits directly; active engine8 gets one dedicated action update.
early_fences.foreign: Entire original Sunny path with incoming AXYP restored.

early_fences.admitted: Before old GuestHurt/MmDeath/SmPose reads, use RdAction/current F7/source hurt clock; do not add native Samus injury blink.

The source per-pixel callbacks already own physical movement. Do not run a second Samus/SMB movement collision pass. Build genuine source-radius hurtbox, then a narrow real coin/vine/pipe/flag/level-interaction pass at the committed coordinates.

Private D0/E0/F0 are the ONLY Rogue weapon records. Skip old Rg/Sm pools/Select/inventory interpretation; advance old Rogue shots BEFORE current player action exactly once per active Main, and render current frames later without another tick.

Rogue has native gear/BCD/missiles, not legacy Samus inventory/tier2.02. Fence direct APIs too, not only the ordinary UI caller; no InvOwned/InvAmmo indexed read for raw2/Rd1. Separate Rogue status view is not a fake PlayerStatus health mirror.

Use actual per-enemy-slot metadata, real visible emergence/contact and a typed native Rogue reward. Read actual PowerUpType,x BEFORE erase. Return consumed/declined explicitly; exactly one erase/score/SFX. Star/1Up retain native SMB owners.
Rogue owns contact admission, native BCD damage/carry and source hurt/knockback/death continuation; skip InventoryHurt/SamusHurtStart/shrink state. Source Screw eligibility, not stale SmFlip.

Explicit freshgame/newlife/real-loaded-area/variant-leave events own clearing. Do not compare AreaPointer or life inequality as an accidental reset. Preserve gear/resources across area; death policy must be explicit and tested.

Map real C94 before the FIRST descriptor/outline read; bypass old Samus freeze/postprocessing. Use current authentic descriptor and native-center anchor, independent original8x8 metadata. Existing8x16 hardware reservation/rotation stays a separate real publication owner.

Rogue-specific palette/SFX routing before old rawSamus/migrated inventory/font-state reads, including NMI/lag paths. No foreground mapper/farcall from an IRQ-sensitive audio path without a separately qualified adapter.

frame_plan: Retain native SMB GameCore/world/enemy order explicitly as a crossover adaptation: PlayerCtrl before ordinary SMB enemy updates, unlike Rogue original Main. Do not claim original room/AI order.

On exactly one unpaused engine8 update: owner/lifecycle admission; copy canonical held/fresh (source16=12 in actual gameplay code); decrement nonzero native2A; import real player center/page/environment.
Advance private old projectiles in D0/E0/F0 order, real tile/contact effect boundaries and authentic animation. Do not update newborn shots until next Main.

Call complete frozen RdControlStep once. It invokes the real terrain/position/draw semantic callbacks at source instruction order. Source hurt70 is already decremented internally; do not double-tick it.
Export actual committed world position/state/facing and bounds, perform real host interaction/scroll; increment native2D only after this completed update.
Ordinary SMB enemy AI/contact follows; the exact-owner body/damage gates use current source pose/gear and real target geometry, never old SmFlip/AvSamusMode.

PlayerGfxHandler selects current native pose/CHR; host DrawAll emits authentic weapons/body exactly once if rendering budget admits it. B metadata runs every action Main even if host publication is skipped; do not label it a physical epoch.
All publish->full256DMA->hardware->wholePPU linkage remains the existing strict observer responsibility; no semantic metadata backfills missing displayed bodies.

geometry_contract.coordinates: Native RdX/Y are center low bytes. Choose fixed host anchor center=(Player worldX+8, Player worldY+16); use real page/high-Y carry on every signed one-pixel commit, not radius-dependent top relocation. Actor/source room high is adapted to host page; do not mask SMB pages to1.
geometry_contract.query: Pure read of actual Block_Buffer_1 two-page208-byte buffers with real loaded-page/window validity and metatile class. Do not use source6000..67FF rooms. Existing ExpandedMapCell is only a reference: its coarse nonzero/23/26/C2 classifier is NOT a sufficient player head/side/feet/coin/vine contract.
geometry_contract.head: Probe current source-radius span at the proposed one-pixel head crossing; distinguish crossing the true cell bottom from touching a pipe SIDE. On an actual head hit retain native buffer pointer/R2 row/ObjectOffset and invoke real bump/questionblock response only once, without shifting world blocks.
geometry_contract.sides: Source radius/center, first solid hit, left/right page edges. Refuse the pixel without forcing player X/Y or installing native Enemy_State stun values.
geometry_contract.support: Actual floor/platform/frozen-enemy top admission; carry semantics match source blocked/committed gates, then real native ball bounce or upright stop. Platform release/carry must have its owning actor/axis, not stale shared collision flags.
geometry_contract.unmorph: Stage true center and source offsets; full up clearance probe and first-hit return; commit only the genuine source-requested successful coordinate.
geometry_contract.environment: Normal/water policy from actual host scene; native suit/speed/gravity behavior stays dedicated. No global Samus or Mario physics fallback.
geometry_contract.interactions: Coins/vines/pipe/flag/axe and breakable changes remain actual native host routines with genuine metadata. Their typed adapters are not implemented by the current helper prototype.

draw_context_B.derivation: Run actual original62:DE4A for every admitted current pose and both facings; table stores its true returnX. F7 returns0. Unsupported frame/skin/facing fails closed. Foreign SMB actors and private weapons do NOT contribute to this declared virtual pre-draw context.
draw_context_B.source_effect: Native D0CD LDA CCC0,X writes0315/RdAcceleration, NOT morph cooldown2A. This adaptation removes dependence on SMB/shuffled/projectile OAM context while retaining per-pose native opcode-window behavior. It is not a repair of a missing TAX.
draw_context_B.callback_liveness_obligation: Source action continuation after drawing consumes contextual X. Before implementation, verify A/Y/P liveness at every real return; bridge preserves whichever callback AXYP semantics is supplied. Helpers prove X/pose admission, not original renderer returnAXYP/hardware output.

items_and_BCD.planned_crossover_delivery_NOT_yet_adopt: Raw SMB mushroom0 -> genuine native energy tank/BCD heal; flower1 -> deterministic next native gear (Bomb/High/Wall/Screw/Spring/Suit/Wave/Ice), then native missile tank. Exact progression order and missile availability need ROOT product approval before implementation; do not silently call it original Rogue room placement.
items_and_BCD.native_commits: Gear61:A667 OR; EnergyTank61:A68D cap6 with native BCD fill; MissileTank62:DD97 +5 current/max saturating255. Regional item0 A257 map-script path has no SMB room equivalent and must be explicitly excluded/adapted, never fake room74.
items_and_BCD.actor_slot: Reuse actual InvPickup/Owner/Rise metadata per native6-slot actor under exact owner; reserve typed reward kind range through ROOT, not unapproved numeric IDs. Real visible emergence, mature collision and one erase/score/SFX required. No tier/gear/ammo/health/outcome seeds in earned fixtures.
items_and_BCD.damage: Port native62:CE92..CED9 arithmetic/suit/contact admission into host segment; feed its real BCD result/carry to frozen RdControlDamageComplete atCEDA. Never ordinary PlayerStatus or hosted Samus HP. Real source damage-type mapping to SMB contacts must be declared and source-qualified.
items_and_BCD.effects: Private projectile actions/real geometry drive attack classes; native attack admission63:F0B4 remains genuine. Source enemy-specific DA92/F579 effect rules must be translated to typed SMB targets, not copied Enemy_State values or old Samus360-timer assumptions. These adapters are pending.

lifecycle_camera_audio.lifecycle: Use explicit native freshgame/area-load/newlife/variant-commit hooks. Loaded identity=(AreaType<<5)|AreaAddrsLOffset, never AreaPointer. Do not spend protected5FB6 as an unapproved cache: explicit once-per-event reset avoids it. Clear private shots/active state at scene exit; no stale source skin/palette lease on ordinary Samus return.
lifecycle_camera_audio.scripted_transitions: Normal active movement is dedicated Rogue. Real SMB pipe/vine/flag/entrance scripts may own coordinates under a documented host-transition adapter; never route those to old Samus state. Source action5/9 callbacks require actual host scene owner and cannot silently be normal motion.
lifecycle_camera_audio.camera: Committed world delta only; bounded existing guest follow/catch-up with real page carry and no arbitrary position forcing. Probe camera drift using x-camera, not only per-step limits. Six-pixel allowance, if ever required, must be gated exact Rogue and demonstrated; no global limit increase.
lifecycle_camera_audio.audio: Private authentic7-byte request image is already source-derived. Add an explicit owner/queue adapter; do not let rawSamus select the ordinary Metroid driver silently. Authentic Rogue APU/data playback is NOT qualified here and may require a separately allocated source-audio component; any SMB cue/music substitution must be declared as adaptation.
lifecycle_camera_audio.pause: Freeze dedicated action/weapon timers under real pause/worldfreeze; keep physical held history updated without synthetic Fresh on resume. No extra callbacks from NMI.

code_budget_estimate_NOT_linked.excluded: Authentic new Rogue audio driver/data; shared-root gate growth; actual branch/alignment/build results. No whole host fit claim until assembled.

positive_bridge_cost.excludes: Real A95 service body, its RTS6CPU and original control callsite JSR when present.
positive_bridge_cost.warning: Repeated per-pixel callbacks multiply this cost. Complete assembled action+host caller cycles/native cadence are mandatory; no zero-cost or60Hz claim.
positive_bridge_cost.stack: Bridge-only cells reachSP149 at entrySP160; real ISR seams from entrySP176 reachSP144. Deeper real host helpers remain unqualified; resident SMCCODE occupies015A..017A.

acceptance_controls_required: All rawID/variant transitions and foreign byte/state equivalence; no overlay reads before exact ownership.
